Package index

BLAST searches

Run BLAST+ searches for query sequences, in parallel or serially, and inspect per-query exit codes.

parallel_blast()
Run Parallelized BLAST
get_blast_results()
Get Formatted BLAST Results
run_blast()
Run BLAST
exit_codes()
Retrieve Exit Codes and Standard Error from BLASTr Results

BLAST databases

Build and query local BLAST databases.

make_blast_db()
Make BLAST Database
get_fasta_header()
Get Sequence Headers from Subject IDs
parse_fasta()
Parse FASTA File into Sequences

Taxonomy

Resolve NCBI Taxonomy IDs or organism names into full taxonomic lineages via the NCBI E-utilities (no command-line tool needed).

parallel_get_tax()
Retrieve Taxonomic Ranks for a List of NCBI Taxonomy Tax IDs in Parallel
get_tax_by_taxID()
Retrieve Taxonomic Ranks Using NCBI Taxonomy Tax IDs
get_tax_by_name()
Retrieve Taxonomic Ranks Using Organism Names

Sequence quality control

Primer checks on raw FASTQ reads (pure R, no external tool).

search_primers_on_fq()
Count Primer Occurrences in FASTQ Files

Setup and utilities

install_dependencies()
Install Required Command-line Tool Dependencies
get_blastr_cache()
Retrieve System-Dependent Cache Path for BLASTr
